crossRefs.note: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired…
For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

translations.web: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
translations.bsb: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field.
translations.kjv: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
translations.asv: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
